review.method: Assistant read every polished transcript turn sequentially without keyword/speaker filtering, then authored sparse markers and context exclusions; deterministic validation of provenance and references.

coverage.parserBodyAccounting: all non-whitespace body content accounted for

review.limitation: Full reading is not an independent second annotator or a gold-standard recall measurement. Source transcription uncertainty retained.

summary: One current day near Tokra: pre-dawn lair check → tunnel → northern fort → tower fight and mist rescue → nearby interrogation/rest → compressed town return. Opening prior-night prologue and closing rest ambiguity remain explicit.
issues: YAML July 3-only is compatible with wake-to-close action. Literal opening includes previous night: choose and document session-boundary semantics before flagging YAML mismatch.
One short rest is certain; closing recovery could repeat it or be a second rest. Do not sum blindly. No completed closing long rest.
Closing return to town is accepted compressed narration; cure, prisoner handover and northbound departure are intentions rather than individually played completions.
Archives detour canceled by explicit retained-map agreement; do not invent visit.
Riswynn enters mist physically during combat, but no planar crossing is supported. Tower with Laka monks is a different destination.
Chronology of reported werewolf history is approximate; do not resolve inconsistent year estimates by inventing dates.
Mode of outbound travel and horse placement are unclear; map gestures do not support exact coordinates or current whereabouts for mounts.
Local place labels only; no independent vault identity reconciliation or completeness gold standard.
